1981-5147-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5147-6720.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1164-3114-4740-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or higher.
1164-3114-4740-6900.description:
Cast Yawgmoth's Will by paying {2}{B}
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Mirror of Fate by tapping it and exiling it due to Yawgmoth's Will, choosing Mirror of Fate and up to six other cards from exile, then exiling your library and putting the chosen cards on top of your library, ensuring to place Mirror of Fate on top of your library.
Cast Mirror of Fate from the top of your library by paying 5 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat from step 2.
1164-3114-4740-6900.notes: You can cast the other spells you exile with Mirror of Fate each loop if your life total allows. You can also start with less life if you've cast spells during the turn prior to starting the combo. Another option is to place small mana value spells on top of Mirror of Fate and cast them to increase your storm count so Aetherflux Reservoir will give you more life faster.

1339-1832-5231-7452.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-7452.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

728-6258--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

1818-1981-2415-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

955-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
955-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4865-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4865-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Chameleon each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4865-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

789-1580-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6607-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

394-3240-5686-6462.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

396-4050-7495-7498.description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it and Blessed Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Biblioplex Tomekeeper trigger, preparing Skycoach Conductor.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

141-5188-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5188-6798.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-4316-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4316-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3263-3814-6871.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

2719-7073.easyPrerequisites:
Pramikon and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces are naming different directions.
You have at least two opponents.
2719-7073.description: Because Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Pramikon disagree on the direction in which players can attack, players are unable to attack at all so long as there are three or more players.
2719-7073.notes: Here is a relevant ruling from Pramikon relating to this lock: "If two Pramikons on the battlefield disagree on which direction three or more players must attack, players can't attack at all. (2019-08-23)"

586-997-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

413-1681-4140.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
When Twilight Shepherd enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

339-677-955-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1238-2351-5396-5467-5686.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Wylie Duke to become a Kraken until end of turn.
Activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 2.

560-2034-4593-6097.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-6097.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

560-2034-3641-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-3641-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

650-6553-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2558-3000-4779-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

5411-5720-5721-6664.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
5411-5720-5721-6664.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2018-4053-5686.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
2018-4053-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature without flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

413-4275-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
413-4275-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token created in step 3.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4186-5445.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
2034-4186-5445.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
2034-4186-5445.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

277-2034-3875-5552.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
277-2034-3875-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-2837-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate two Cats by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

147-3331-5220-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
147-3331-5220-5256.description:
Cast Thunderous Debut by paying {6}{G}{G} and sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Thunderous Debut.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dualcaster Mage on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dualcaster Mage's power.
Resolve the copy of Thunderous Debut, causing you to look at the top twenty cards of your library and put Dualcaster Mage and up to one other creature card onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

499-1350-2713-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1294-2167-3909-4423-4482.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands and one basic Forest.
1294-2167-3909-4423-4482.description:
Activate a Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Summer Bloom by paying {1}{G}, allowing you to play three more lands this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or from your graveyard.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, putting Summer Bloom on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Nurturing Peatland by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Summer Bloom from the top of your library.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and a Forest, adding {G}{U}.
Play the Forest and Nurturing Peatland from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1874-2034-3490-3514.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1874-2034-3490-3514.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Karlov triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Ajani's Welcome.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1156-4499-4659.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Pia and Kiran.
Pia and Kiran enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Thopter creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the two Thopters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1193-1308-3209.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna targeting Anointed Procession, creating two token copies of Anointed Procession.
Cast Sprout Swarm, paying for Buyback to create eight 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
Cast Sprout Swarm paying for Buyback, tapping five Saprolings with convoke.
Repeat step 3.

738-4050-4733-5004.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Cathodion and Dictate of Erebos trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Dictate of Erebos's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.

985-1976-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
